lines.3: 「Well, well. Two students living together. Must be nice.」
lines.4: She teased me while twirling her prized golden hair around one finger.
lines.5: 「But since it's Otome, there's no danger of it becoming a problem.」
lines.6: 「There is nothing improper, but please keep it quiet.」
lines.7: 「Fine by me. I'll keep it quiet for you.」
lines.8: 「Still, living under the same roof as a slender beauty like Otome...」
lines.9: 「Are you having the time of your life, Leo?」
lines.10: 「He was looking at Otome like a wild beast.」
lines.11: 「I told you, quit making jokes that aren't funny.」
lines.12: 「I-it's not like I'm having the time of my life.」
lines.13: 「She does correct my everyday habits a lot. Sometimes it helps, but sometimes it gets annoying.」
lines.14: Damn it. The Princess was the one person I had not wanted to find out.
lines.15: 「Um... What are you doing about bedrooms?」
lines.16: 「I am on the first floor. Leo is on the second.」
lines.20: 「Whew! That was delicious. I'm completely satisfied.」
lines.21: 「That will do for today. It was rather entertaining. We have work to do, so come again tomorrow.」
lines.22: One word from the boss, and the gathering broke up.
lines.24: She beckoned me over with a curl of her finger.
lines.29: My innocent heart gave a powerful thump.
